---
applyTo: "frontend/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}"
---

# Frontend Instructions

- Read `docs/architecture/frontend.md` before changing frontend structure.
- Follow `docs/engineering/frontend-best-practices.md`.
- Keep business logic outside presentational components.
- Reuse existing UI components and utilities before adding new abstractions.
- Handle loading, error, empty, and success states where applicable.
- Preserve responsive behavior and keyboard accessibility.
- Run the narrowest relevant frontend validation after changes.
